content.title: 2026’s Biggest AI Trends: The Memory Explosion | MU Stock, SNDK Stock, SK Hynix, CAMT Stock
content.description:
24/7 Wall St. Analysts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith are kicking the New Year off in style with 12 trends for AI investors to watch in 2026. Over the course of 12 videos, the two will share their thoughts on everything from the memory explosion to software stocks to robotics.

In this video we'll discuss why memory stocks like SanDisk (Nasdaq: SNDK), Micron (Nasdaq: MU), and SK Hynix took off in 2025 and why their stocks are continuing to run in 2026. We'll also discuss some strategies for investing in the trend in 2026 such as buying semiconductor equipment companies in the space like Camtek (Nasdaq: CAMT).

content.title: Best Stock Trade of 2025 Keeps Running, Question Is for How Long
content.summary: Memory and storage companies were the leading performers in the S&P 500 Index last year, as the massive amounts of cash being spent on building out AI infrastructure trickled down to some traditionally staid parts of the tech sector.  Sandisk popped 16% on the first trading day of the year and then soared 28% on Tuesday after Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang highlighted the need for more memory and storage in the AI ecosystem.  Meanwhile, Western Digital, Seagate and Micron have all posted double-digit percentage gains to start 2026, although all three stocks fell on Wednesday.
